name: Konark Sun Temple
description: The 13th-century stone chariot of the Sun God, carved with 24 giant wheels, near Chandrabhaga Beach.

name: Shree Jagannath Temple
description: One of India’s holiest pilgrimages and home of the world-famous Rath Yatra.

name: Lingaraj Temple
description: The grandest of Bhubaneswar’s 11th-century Kalinga-style temples, in the heart of the old town.

name: Chilika Lake
description: Boat rides to spot Irrawaddy dolphins, island temples, migratory birds, and golden sunsets.

name: Puri Sea Beach
tagline: Sunrise on the Bay of Bengal
description: Golden sand, sunrise walks, and the scenic Puri–Konark Marine Drive.

name: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
tagline: Peace Pagoda on the Daya river
description: The white hilltop stupa marking the Kalinga War site where Emperor Ashoka embraced peace.

name: Bhitarkanika National Park
description: Boat safaris through India’s second-largest mangrove forest, home to giant saltwater crocodiles, spotted deer, and migratory birds.

name: Similipal Tiger Reserve
tagline: Home of the rare black tiger
description: Dense sal forests, the Barehipani and Joranda waterfalls, and the only wild melanistic tigers in the world.
